readings.title: The Call to Active Trust
readings.subtitle: Declaring the Wonders of YeHoVaH Among the Nations
readings.text: [Psalm 105:1] Give thanks to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>! Call upon <dn>His</dn> Name, Make known <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> deeds among the peoples. [2] Sing to <dn>Him</dn>, sing praise to <dn>Him</dn>; Speak of all <dn>His</dn> wonders. [3] Make your boast in <dn>His</dn> set-apart Name; Let the hearts rejoice of those seeking <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [4] Seek <dn>את</dn> <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and <dn>His</dn> strength; Seek <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> face always.

readings.subsection: The Structural Guarantee of the Promised Inheritance
readings.title: The Everlasting Oth and Covenant
readings.subtitle: Remembering the Oath Established to Aḇraham, Yitsḥaq, and Yaʽaqoḇ
readings.text: [5] Remember <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> wonders which <dn>He</dn> has done, <dn>His</dn> miracles, and the right-rulings of <dn>His</dn> mouth, [6] O seed of Aḇraham <dn>His</dn> servant, Children of Yaʽaqoḇ, <dn>His</dn> chosen ones! [7] <dn>He</dn> is <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> our <dn>Elohim</dn>; <dn>His</dn> right-rulings are in all the earth. [8] <dn>He</dn> has remembered <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> covenant forever, The Word <dn>He</dn> commanded, for a thousand generations, [9] The covenant <dn>He</dn> made with Aḇraham, And <dn>His</dn> oath to Yitsḥaq, [10] And established it to Yaʽaqoḇ for a law, To Yisra’ĕl – an everlasting covenant, [11] Saying, <dq>“To you <dn>I</dn> give the land of Kenaʽan, The portion of your inheritance.”</dq>

readings.title: Shielding the Sojourners
readings.subtitle: Providential Covering Over the Chosen Lineage
readings.text: [12] When they were few in number, Few indeed, and sojourners in it, [13] And they went about from one nation to another, From one reign to another people, [14] <dn>He</dn> allowed no one to oppress them, And <dn>He</dn> reproved <dn>את</dn> sovereigns for their sakes, [15] Saying, <dq>“Do not touch <dn>My</dn> anointed ones, And do <dn>My</dn> prophets no evil.”</dq>

readings.subsection: The Subjection to Testing and Scarcity
readings.title: The Crucible of Famine
readings.subtitle: The Righteous Testing of Yosĕph Before the Appointed Time
readings.text: [16] And <dn>He</dn> called for a scarcity of food in the land; <dn>He</dn> cut off <dn>את</dn> all the supply of bread. [17] <dn>He</dn> sent ahead of them a man, Yosĕph, sold as a slave. [18] They afflicted his feet with shackles, His neck was put in irons. [19] Until the time that <dn>His</dn> Word came, The Word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> tried <dn>את</dn> him.

readings.title: Exaltation in Mitsrayim
readings.subtitle: The Sovereign Release and Multiplication of Yisra’ĕl
readings.text: [20] The sovereign sent and released him, The ruler of the people let him loose. [21] <dn>He</dn> made him master of his house, And ruler over all his possessions, [22] To bind <dn>את</dn> his chiefs at his pleasure, And to teach <dn>את</dn> his elders wisdom. [23] Then Yisra’ĕl came to Mitsrayim, And Yaʽaqoḇ sojourned in the land of Ḥam. [24] And <dn>He</dn> increased <dn>His</dn> people greatly, And made them stronger than their enemies. [25] <dn>He</dn> turned <dn>את</dn> their heart to hate <dn>His</dn> people, To conspire against <dn>His</dn> servants.

readings.title: The Systematic Dismantling of Mitsrayim
readings.subtitle: Deploying Plagues to Break the Adversarial Infrastructure
readings.text: [26] <dn>He</dn> sent <dn>את</dn> Mosheh <dn>His</dn> servant, <dn>את</dn> Aharon whom <dn>He</dn> had chosen. [27] They set among them <dn>את</dn> the matters of <dn>His</dn> signs, And wonders in the land of Ḥam. [28] <dn>He</dn> sent <dn>את</dn> darkness, and made it dark; And they did not rebel against <dn>His</dn> word. [29] <dn>He</dn> turned <dn>את</dn> their waters into blood, And killed <dn>את</dn> their fish. [30] Their land teemed with frogs, In the rooms of their sovereigns. [31] <dn>He</dn> spoke, and swarms of flies came, Gnats in all their borders. [32] <dn>He</dn> gave them <dn>את</dn> hail for rain, <dn>את</dn> a flaming fire in their land. [33] And <dn>He</dn> struck <dn>את</dn> their vines and their fig trees, And broke <dn>את</dn> the trees of their borders. [34] <dn>He</dn> spoke, and locusts came, And larvae, innumerable, [35] And they devoured all the plants in their land, And they devoured the fruit of their ground. [36] Then <dn>He</dn> struck <dn>את</dn> all the first-born in their land, The first-fruit of all their strength, [37] And brought <dn>את</dn> them out with silver and gold, And among <dn>His</dn> tribes no one faltered. [38] Mitsrayim was glad when they left, For the fear of them had fallen upon them.

readings.title: The Wealth of the Nations and the Provision of Rest
readings.subtitle: A Premial Release Directed Toward Guarding Torah
readings.text: [39] <dn>He</dn> spread a cloud for a covering, And fire to give light in the night. [40] They asked, and <dn>He</dn> brought quail, And satisfied them with the bread of heaven. [41] <dn>He</dn> opened the rock, and water gushed out; It ran in the dry places, a river. [42] For <dn>He</dn> remembered <dn>His</dn> set-apart word, To Aḇraham <dn>His</dn> servant. [43] So <dn>He</dn> brought out <dn>His</dn> people with joy, <dn>His</dn> chosen ones with singing. [44] And <dn>He</dn> gave to them <dn>את</dn> the lands of the nations, And they inherited <dn>את</dn> the labour of peoples, [45] In order that they might guard <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> laws, And watch over <dn>His</dn> Torot. Praise Yah!

readings.title: The Petition for Premial Deliverance
readings.subtitle: Seeking Deliverance to Rejoice with the Inheritance
readings.text: [Psalm 106:1] Praise Yah! Oh, give thanks to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, For <dn>He</dn> is good! For <dn>His</dn> loving-commitment is everlasting. [2] Who does relate <dn>את</dn> the mighty acts of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>? Or declare <dn>את</dn> all <dn>His</dn> praise? [3] Blessed are those who guard <dn>את</dn> right-ruling, Who do <dn>את</dn> righteousness at all times! [4] Remember me, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, in the acceptance of Your people; Visit me with Your deliverance, [5] To see the good of Your chosen ones, To rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, To make my boast with Your inheritance.

readings.title: Rebellion at the Sea of Reeds
readings.subtitle: Divine Salvation Orchestrated Solely to Magnify His Name
readings.text: [6] We have sinned with our fathers, We have acted perversely, We have done wrong. [7] Our fathers in Mitsrayim did not understand Your wonders; They did not remember <dn>את</dn> Your many loving-commitments, But rebelled by the sea, the Sea of Reeds. [8] But <dn>He</dn> saved them for <dn>His</dn> Name’s sake, To make known <dn>His</dn> might. [9] And <dn>He</dn> rebuked <dn>את</dn> the Sea of Reeds, and it dried up; And <dn>He</dn> led them through the depths, Through a wilderness. [10] And <dn>He</dn> saved them from the hand of the hater, And redeemed them from the hand of the enemy. [11] And waters covered their adversaries; Not one of them was left. [12] Then they believed <dn>His</dn> words; They sang <dn>His</dn> praise.

readings.title: Lust and Insurrection in the Wilderness
readings.subtitle: The Consuming Flame Upon the Camp of Dathan and Aḇiram
readings.text: [13] They soon forgot <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> works; They did not wait for <dn>His</dn> counsel, [14] But greedily lusted in the wilderness, And tried <dn>Ĕl</dn> in the desert. [15] And <dn>He</dn> gave them their request, But sent leanness within their being. [16] And they were jealous of Mosheh in the camp, Of Aharon, the set-apart one of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, [17] Then the earth opened up and swallowed Dathan, And covered the company of Aḇiram. [18] And a fire burned in their company; A flame consumed the wrong.

readings.subsection: The Forfeiture of Glory and False Worship
readings.title: The Golden Calf at Ḥorĕḇ
readings.subtitle: The Intercessory Stand of Mosheh in the Breach
readings.text: [19] They made <dn>את</dn> a calf in Ḥorĕḇ, And bowed down to a moulded image. [20] Thus they changed <dn>My</dn> esteem Into the form of an ox that eats grass. [21] They forgot <dn>את</dn> <dn>Ĕl</dn> their Saviour, The Doer of great deeds in Mitsrayim, [22] Of wonders in the land of Ḥam, Of awesome deeds by the Sea of Reeds. [23] Then <dn>He</dn> said that <dn>He</dn> would destroy them, Had not Mosheh <dn>His</dn> chosen one stood before <dn>Him</dn> in the breach, To turn away <dn>His</dn> wrath from destroying them.

readings.subsection: Despising the Promise and Provoking the Creator
readings.title: The Snare of Baʽal Peʽor
readings.subtitle: The Righteous Intervention of Pineḥas and the Waters of Meriḇah
readings.text: [24] They then despised <dn>את</dn> the pleasant land; They did not believe <dn>His</dn> word, [25] And they grumbled in their tents, They did not listen to <dn>את</dn> the voice of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [26] So <dn>He</dn> lifted up <dn>His</dn> hand in an oath against them, To make them fall in the wilderness, [27] And to make their seed fall among the nations, And to scatter them in the lands. [28] And they joined themselves to Baʽal Peʽor, And ate slaughterings made to the dead. [29] Thus they provoked <dn>Him</dn> with their deeds, And the plague broke out among them. [30] Then Pineḥas stood up and intervened, And the plague was stopped. [31] And that was reckoned to him for righteousness To all generations forever. [32] And they provoked wrath at the waters of Meriḇah, And Mosheh suffered on account of them; [33] Because they embittered his spirit, And he spoke rashly with his lips.

readings.title: The Sin of Compromise and Contamination
readings.subtitle: Defiling the Land Through Child Sacrifice and Idolatry
readings.text: [34] They did not destroy <dn>את</dn> the peoples, As <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded them, [35] But mixed with the nations And learned their works, [36] And served <dn>את</dn> their idols, And they became a snare to them. [37] And they slaughtered <dn>את</dn> their sons And <dn>את</dn> their daughters to demons, [38] And they shed <dn>את</dn> innocent blood, The blood of their sons and daughters, Whom they slaughtered to the idols of Kenaʽan; And the land was defiled with blood. [39] So they became unclean by their own works, And went whoring by their own deeds.

readings.subsection: The Cosmic Verdict and Future Hope
readings.title: The Cycle of Judgment and Compassion
readings.subtitle: A Final Cry to Gather the Remnant from Babylon
readings.text: [40] And the wrath of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> burned against <dn>His</dn> people, And <dn>He</dn> loathed <dn>His</dn> own inheritance. [41] Then <dn>He</dn> gave them into the hand of the nations, And those who hated them ruled over them. [42] And their enemies oppressed them, And they were humbled under their hand. [43] Many times <dn>He</dn> delivered them; But they rebelled in their plans, So they were brought low for their crookedness. [44] But <dn>He</dn> would look on their distress, When <dn>He</dn> heard their cry, [45] And remember <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> covenant for their sake, And relent according to the greatness of <dn>His</dn> loving-commitment. [46] And <dn>He</dn> would let them find compassion, Before all those holding them captive. [47] Save <dn>את</dn> us, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> our <dn>Elohim</dn>, And gather us from among the nations, To give thanks to Your set-apart Name, To exult in Your praise. [48] Blessed be <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’ĕl From everlasting to everlasting! And all the people shall say, “Amĕn!” Praise Yah!
